qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (No hidden requirements; coverage has two directions)
evidence: Built the criterion->requirement map for all 55 criteria (render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3); frozen instruction.md, environment/instructions and tests are byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools (diff -rq empty), including commit 501d01af. Every graded demand traces to a public line or a professional default: editor surface/no textarea/no ready-made editor (ui.md:3); line/column from 1, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End, Shift+Arrow, Ctrl+A, sticky column, graphemes, scroll-into-view (ui.md:5); double/triple-click/drag, copy, replace-selection, one-step paste undo, unwrapped long line, block Tab/Shift+Tab incl. next-line exclusion and in-line selection (ui.md:7); Alt and Ctrl/Cmd+Click, same-line carets, slow-burst single Undo/Redo, Undo restores caret, greyed Undo/Redo after New/open, idempotent Format (ui.md:9); literal case-sensitive Find with dot/bracket, both wraps, Replace current advances and never lands on inserted text, Replace all one step and Redo cleared after new edit (ui.md:11); five/four distinct colour categories plus function name same at declaration and call (ui.md:13); JS/HTML two-space format preserving strings/comments/behaviour, one Undo/Redo, error message leaves draft (ui.md:15); labels, focus, shown escape shortcut, textual feedback after Run/Save/Format, focus back to code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save, unsaved sign incl. Undo-to-saved, 390px usability (ui.md:17); fresh isolated run, HTML onclick, console order, one-based lines incl. whole-file HTML and unhandled rejections with real message, syntax error leaves draft, output kept before failure (behaviour.md:3); last-good restore incl. typed fields and canvas, 5s budget incl. timers/promises and fresh per-interaction budget, Run again (behaviour.md:5); Stop and newer Run cancel leftovers (behaviour.md:7); exact Save, storage-independent reload, restart durability, stale Save refused with message and draft kept (behaviour.md:9); live library within ~5s (criteria allow 10s) without disturbing draft/caret/scroll/Undo/fields, newer-revision notice (behaviour.md:11); read-only history, restore adds revision keeping history, old page cannot overwrite, restores as visible HTTP requests, replayed restore adds no revision (behaviour.md:13, now restore-only, matching cw_restore_request_repeat_safe); preview cannot read/change parent title or origin storage, no-cors fetch to localhost and 127.0.0.1 must fail (security.md:3); eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import refused with feedback, strings/comments harmless, source saved as text (security.md:5); health address answered (integration.md:3). Criteria avoid hidden specifics: no exact labels, routes, colours, selectors, revision-number format, date display, quote style, conflict wording or saved label (cw_unsaved_marker says a positive 'saved' label is not required; cw_html_semantic_coloring forbids requiring DOM tags/classes; functional prompt.md:23-24 forbids exact wording and guessed routes). Probed counterexamples: (a) a conforming app whose restore is Save-from-old-revision with a base revision: replay is stale-refused, so it passes; (b) an app that collapses selection after block Tab would fail the Shift+Tab leg, but keeping the selection is the professional default and ui.md:7 requires outdenting every touched line; (c) cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget demands a visible time-limit reason for an interaction's endless callbacks, which follows from behaviour.md:5 ('goes over the five-second run budget, tell me why' together with 'the callbacks from that interaction get a fresh five seconds of their own'), so it is a reasonable reading rather than a reference-only rule; (d) unhandled async rejection must report the throwing line (4), consistent with 'line number ... for a Promise rejection'. Visual likert anchors judge craft (contrast, alignment, caret/selection visibility, spacing) without taste or hue requirements (visual prompt.md:22). No sign-in is graded (app_context.md:10). No criterion found that grades something the brief or a professional default does not require. This is a static rubric-to-brief review; whether the golden passes these criteria at runtime belongs to other rows and was not measured here.
